name: whatsie
description:
Whatsie is a native Linux desktop client for WhatsApp Web, built on Qt 6 and
QtWebEngine. It brings WhatsApp out of the browser tab and into a proper
desktop application — lightweight and fast, with system integration, privacy
controls, and customization options a plain browser cannot offer.

Core features:

- Light, dark and follow-system themes, kept in step with WhatsApp Web

- Native desktop notifications with contact avatars

- System-tray icon with an unread badge, mute and do-not-disturb

- Voice, video and screen-share calls (Wayland via the desktop portal)

- Built-in download manager with history; drag-and-drop and paste of attachments

- Spell check for your system language

- App lock with a passcode and configurable lock on start, on hide, or after idle

- Privacy blur to hide message text and media until you hover

More controls:

- Per-site camera, microphone and location permissions

- HTTP / SOCKS5 network proxy with authentication

- Autostart at login and start minimized to the tray

- Single instance with multiple-account profiles

- Zoom and interface scaling, plus a keyboard-shortcuts sheet

- One-click bug reporting with diagnostics, no messages included

Note: Whatsie is an unofficial third-party client and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with WhatsApp or Meta Platforms, Inc.
